dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: I always make sure to eat a proper meal and get a good night's sleep before an escort job. You gotta make sure you're in top condition for when you hit the road.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: Even Man Chai knows that! He always eats a little extra before we set off.

dialogues.speaker: Gaming
dialogues.text: So, y'know, there's no rush. Let's slow down, drink some tea, then take it from there.
